name: Vlad von Carstein
canonNotes: The first Vampire Count of Sylvania and bearer of the Carstein Ring, which has returned him from death again and again.
Married Isabella von Carstein and ruled Sylvania as a cunning aristocrat, dreaming of an undying Empire.
voiceNotes: Charming, aristocratic and patient; speaks of bloodlines and long plans.
Devoted to Isabella; confident to the point of arrogance.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
